This week, we continued fixing bugs. Once again thank you to the community who actively help us resolve them. Here are this week's additions and changes:

[b]->[/b] Retrowave World Steam badges and trading cards are now available.
[b]->[/b] A new car dealership is available in Dream Island: Vapor Automotive.
[b]->[/b] A new car is available: RIFLE.
[b]->[/b] A new car is available: TOFU.
[b]->[/b] A new car is available: POLONAISE.
[b]->[/b] A new achievement is available upon entering Vapor Automotive.
[b]->[/b] The achievement "ARCADE FIREBALL 6" has been added.
[b]->[/b] The achievement "ARCADE FIREBALL 7" has been added.
[b]->[/b] You can now sit on the benches, chairs of the city.
[b]->[/b] You can now buy the Pizza Shop on real estate.
[b]->[/b] You can now stop time challenge in the map window (J key).
[b]->[/b] You can now see your personal ranking ( if +100 ) in the leaderboards by clicking on your rank.
[b]->[/b] You can now see people entering and exiting the game in chat.
[b]->[/b] You can now see car used on each time challenge in leaderboard.
[b]->[/b] You can now open map inside the building.
[b]->[/b] Your car stays parked in the same place when you enter and exit a building.
[b]->[/b] The gear engaged is visible in the compatible dashboard in interior view.
[b]->[/b] The car brakes have been improved.
[b]->[/b] Chat is no longer invasive in SHARK and PALM CUSTOM (You can open it with "T").
[b]->[/b] Improve visibility of your character while driving in the minimap.
[b]->[/b] The translation of the interface into Simplified Chinese has been improved by a professional translator.

A DLC to support the development of the game has been added.
Keep in mind that this DLC offers no real in-game benefits other than cosmetics.
A big thank you in advance to everyone who buys it!

Retrowave World - Supporter Pack

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000540/Retrowave_World__Supporter_Pack/


All this week we have been updating several times to remove the many bugs present when the game was released. There are still some, but thanks to all of you, the game is now much more playable and enjoyable.
In addition to fixing bugs, we will now be able to focus on new content to add to the game.

[b]->[/b] Unlocked characters are now visible in the menu.
[b]->[/b] Option to stop the camera from returning to the center of the screen while driving has been added.
[b]->[/b] Inversion of X and Y axis controls independently possible.
[b]->[/b] The “Help” menu has been added.
[b]->[/b] Due to inflation, Route69 beer is now $5 a pint and no longer free.
[b]->[/b] Female characters now have a female scream when jumping.
[b]->[/b] The number of VHS found is now displayed in the passport.
[b]->[/b] A very large number of bugs have been fixed.


[b]Hope you enjoy this update![/b]

notes.title: ＲＥＴＲＯＷＡＶＥ　ＷＯＲＬＤ
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Night Runners,[/b]

There will surely be some disappointed people but no, Retrowave World will not be released today. 

The early access of the game is ready (obviously far from perfect, a lot of development awaits us after the release) but currently the game is under review by the Steam team and it is impossible for us to change the date. 

The final release date will be between May 6 and 10, and this is final. Even if some players may say that the game is not complete enough, we will accept these criticisms and we are counting on the caring community of the Retrowave world to help us in the future development of the game. 

Rewindapp is still a small independent studio of 2 passionate developers. 
We thank you for all your messages of encouragement and once again there will be no new release date, this one will be final.

Hoping to see you soon driving your sports car under the palm trees and the sunset of the wonderful universe of Retrowave World.

[b]Dear Night Runners,[/b]

Just to announce that the [b]Retrowave World[/b] DEMO is available and can be downloaded from the game's Steam page.

We are waiting for your feedback on the community hub! ːvaporwaveeː

Don't hesitate to add the game to your [b][i]WISHLIST[/i][/b] and [i][b]FOLLOW[/b][/i] it, it encourages us and helps us enormously.

We are full-time developing the game so that it will be available before the end of the year and allow you to have an unforgettable nostalgic experience.

Thanks to everyone who took the time to try the DEMO.

See you soon in Retrowave World! ːretrowaveː
